🧚‍♀️ Welcome to Winx Club: Magix! 🌟

Step into the magical world of Alfea and become the fairy you were always meant to be! ✨
Customize your fairy, decorate your dorm, master spells, and explore Magix with your friends!

🦋 Choose your fairy type and unlock unique powers
👗 Mix & match magical outfits and accessories
🛏 Personalize your very own dorm room
📚 Help Faragonda, Wizgiz, and other familiar characters in magical quests

🌀 Race through flying hoop courses
⚔ Battle dark forces with spells and fairy combos
🌎 Roleplay, make friends, and live your fairy life!
✨ Get ready to join the club!


🪄 New content, updates & seasonal events coming soon!
